zh.title: 華航10月16日起調漲行李相關費用 最高漲幅約3成
zh.summary: 華航公告10月16日起開立機票調漲超額行李費、預購行李費及寵物託運費；最高漲幅約3成
body: 中華航空近日公告，自今年10月16日起開立機票，將調整超額行李費、預購行李費，漲幅約1成多至3成，此外寵物託運費也有調整。
華航透過文字說明，依據市場動態檢視各項附加服務收費標準，有關超額行李費、預購行李費及寵物託運費調整，適用於10月16日起開立的機票，相關收費標準可參考華航網站公告，提供旅客查詢。
根據華航公告內容，臺灣往返第1區（日本、韓國、帛琉、關島、香港、中國、菲律賓、泰國、馬來西亞、新加坡、印尼、越南、柬埔寨）超額行李費，由原本140美元（新臺幣4494元）調漲至160美元（新臺幣約5136元），漲幅約14.29%。
第2區（澳洲、紐西蘭、印度等）超額行李費，則由原本170美元（新臺幣5457元），調整至210美元（新臺幣6741元），漲幅23.53%；第3區（洛杉磯、安大略、舊金山、西雅圖、紐約、溫哥華、鳳凰城、夏威夷、阿姆斯特丹、法蘭克福、維也納、羅馬、倫敦、布拉格、中東等），漲幅也有約20%。
預購行李費方面，依航線不同，最高漲幅達3成。臺灣往返第1區（日韓、東南亞、港澳、中國等），原先126美元（新臺幣約4044元），漲為152美元（新臺幣約4879元），漲幅20.63%。
第2區（澳洲、紐西蘭、印度等）原先預購行李費153美元（新臺幣4911元），調漲為200美元（新臺幣6420元），漲幅30.72%；第3區（北美長程線如洛杉磯、紐約，歐洲長程線如阿姆斯特丹、法蘭克福等），原先180美元（新臺幣5778元），漲為228美元（新臺幣約7319元），漲幅26.67%。
華航今年1月26日曾調漲超額行李費、預購額外託運行李費及超大尺寸行李費；這次自10月16日起調漲的項目，涵蓋超額行李費、預購行李費及寵物託運費。

en.title: China Airlines to raise baggage-related fees from Oct 16, increases of up to about 30%
en.summary: China Airlines to raise excess, pre-purchased baggage and pet carriage fees on tickets issued from Oct 16; up to about 30%
body: China Airlines has announced that tickets issued from Oct 16 this year will be subject to adjusted excess baggage fees and pre-purchased baggage fees, with increases of roughly 10 percent to 30 percent, and pet carriage fees will also be adjusted.

The carrier said in written remarks that it reviews charges for ancillary services in line with market conditions, and that the adjustments to excess baggage fees, pre-purchased baggage fees and pet carriage fees apply to tickets issued from Oct 16. The fee standards are available on the China Airlines website for passengers to check.

According to the airline's announcement, excess baggage fees for Taiwan services to Zone 1 (Japan, South Korea, Palau, Guam, Hong Kong, China, the Philippines, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Vietnam and Cambodia) rise from US$140 (NT$4,494) to US$160 (about NT$5,136), an increase of about 14.29 percent.

Excess baggage fees for Zone 2 (Australia, New Zealand, India and others) rise from US$170 (NT$5,457) to US$210 (NT$6,741), an increase of 23.53 percent; Zone 3 (Los Angeles, Ontario, San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Vancouver, Phoenix, Hawaii, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Vienna, Rome, London, Prague, the Middle East and others) also sees an increase of about 20 percent.

For pre-purchased baggage fees, increases vary by route and reach as much as 30 percent. Taiwan services to Zone 1 (Japan and South Korea, Southeast Asia, Hong Kong and Macau, China and others) rise from US$126 (about NT$4,044) to US$152 (about NT$4,879), an increase of 20.63 percent.

Zone 2 (Australia, New Zealand, India and others) sees pre-purchased baggage fees rise from US$153 (NT$4,911) to US$200 (NT$6,420), an increase of 30.72 percent; Zone 3 (North American long-haul routes such as Los Angeles and New York, and European long-haul routes such as Amsterdam and Frankfurt) rises from US$180 (NT$5,778) to US$228 (about NT$7,319), an increase of 26.67 percent.

China Airlines previously raised excess baggage fees, pre-purchased additional checked baggage fees and oversized baggage fees on Jan 26 this year. The items being raised from Oct 16 cover excess baggage fees, pre-purchased baggage fees and pet carriage fees.

zh.title: 臺中雙十國慶升旗 5架無人機垂掛國旗飛過府前廣場
zh.summary: 臺中市國慶升旗典禮安排5架無人機垂掛國旗，江啟臣、何欣純出席並談無人載具產業。
body: 臺中市政府今天上午舉辦雙十國慶升旗典禮，安排5架無人機垂掛國旗，以大雁編隊凌空展旗飛過府前廣場，成為典禮焦點。
國民黨、民進黨臺中市長參選人江啟臣、何欣純今天出席這場升旗典禮，兩人後續發表對無人載具產業發展的看法。
江啟臣表示，臺中具備完整的產業鏈、供應鏈，若能有完整的政策搭配並與國際接軌，加上擁有臺中國際會展中心，未來是臺中另個產業大升級的黃金時代；他說，從過去的機械製造基地，到未來的機器人製造基地，許多產業都已經啟動。
江啟臣並提到，日前與無人機聯盟接觸，獲得許多意見，將設法尋找可展示、洽談、交流的地方，希望臺中未來是中部產業的核心，以機械業為基底，發展機器人與無人載具等產業。
何欣純指出，臺中擁有堅強的精密製造與智慧製造實力，具備投入無人載具供應鏈的良好條件，政府應積極協助在地產業把握發展機會。
何欣純表示，過去她在立法院為產業請命、爭取資源，日前參與在臺中舉辦的無人載具產業展覽，以行動支持業者；她強調，支持產業就要協助解決問題，未來力挺產業到底，透過中央地方攜手合作，大力支持無人載具產業發展，也力挺所有在地勞工。

en.title: Taichung National Day ceremony features five drones carrying flags over plaza
en.summary: Taichung holds National Day flag-raising ceremony; five drones fly flags overhead as two mayoral candidates discuss uncrewed vehicle industry.
body: Taichung City Government held a Double Tenth National Day flag-raising ceremony this morning, arranging five drones to carry flags in a formation over the plaza in front of the city hall, which became the focus of the ceremony.

KMT and DPP Taichung mayoral candidates Johnny Chiang (江啟臣) and Ho Hsin-chun (何欣純) attended the flag-raising ceremony today, and the two later shared their views on the development of the uncrewed vehicle industry.

Chiang said Taichung has a complete industrial and supply chain, and that with complete policy support and international connections, plus the Taichung International Convention and Exhibition Center, the future could be a golden era of another major industrial upgrade for Taichung; he said that from a past mechanical manufacturing base to a future robot manufacturing base, many industries have already started.

Chiang also mentioned that he recently contacted the drone alliance and received many opinions, and will seek places for display, negotiation and exchange, hoping Taichung will be the core of central Taiwan's industry, developing robots and uncrewed vehicles based on the machinery sector.

Ho pointed out that Taichung has strong precision manufacturing and smart manufacturing capabilities, and has good conditions for entering the uncrewed vehicle supply chain, and the government should actively help local industries seize development opportunities.

Ho said she has previously spoken up for the industry in the Legislative Yuan and sought resources, and recently participated in an uncrewed vehicle industry exhibition held in Taichung to support operators with action; she stressed that supporting the industry means helping solve problems, and that she will support the industry to the end, working together with central and local governments to strongly support the development of the uncrewed vehicle industry and all local workers.

zh.title: 歐盟航空安全總署發布CS-MMEL簡易查閱規則第4版
zh.summary: EASA發布CS-MMEL簡易查閱規則第4版；納入ED Decision 2025/021/R更新內容
body: 歐盟航空安全總署（EASA）已發布最低設備清單（Master Minimum Equipment List，MMEL）認證規範的簡易查閱規則（Easy Access Rules for CS-MMEL）第4版。
EASA表示，新版簡易查閱規則納入ED Decision 2025/021/R，對CS-MMEL進行例行更新，特別是引入先前尚未納入CS-MMEL、由美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）政策函所涵蓋的項目。
在發布形式上，EASA指出第4版提供新的強化線上版本，具備更佳效能以便快速順暢瀏覽，所有規則條文均有永久連結，並改善篩選與搜尋功能。
EASA並說明，該文件也以機器可讀的XML格式提供，可方便由本機應用程式與搜尋資料庫處理並同步。
EASA表示，該文件透過eRules平臺產生，並將定期更新，以納入後續內容變更與演進。EASA也請使用者透過聯絡表單中的簡易查閱規則專區提供意見與評論。

en.title: EASA publishes Easy Access Rules for CS-MMEL Issue 4
en.summary: EASA publishes Easy Access Rules for CS-MMEL Issue 4; incorporates ED Decision 2025/021/R update
body: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) has published Issue 4 of the Easy Access Rules for Master Minimum Equipment List (EAR for CS-MMEL).

According to EASA, the new edition incorporates ED Decision 2025/021/R, which provides a regular update of CS-MMEL and in particular introduces items covered by Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Policy Letters that had not yet been included in CS-MMEL.

EASA said Issue 4 is available as a new enhanced online publication with optimised performance for quick and seamless navigation, permalinks of all rule articles, and improved filters and search functions.
The agency added that the document is also available in machine-readable XML format that can be easily processed by and synchronised with local applications and search databases.

EASA said the document is generated through the eRules platform and will be updated regularly to incorporate further changes and evolutions to its content. It asked users to send feedback and comments using the Easy Access Rules area on the contact us form.

zh.title: Shield AI稱X-BAT維持年底測試計畫 美國海軍投入資金
zh.summary: Shield AI稱X-BAT維持年底測試計畫；美國海軍執行資金修改案
body: Shield AI表示，X-BAT目前仍以2026年底開始飛行測試為計畫。一支由500名工程師組成的團隊正投入這款自主作戰飛機的研製工作。報導指出，這些工程師來自Shield AI及主要供應商，包括提供引擎的GE Aerospace。
美國海軍已為X-BAT執行一項附有資金的修改案。Shield AI將以自有資金配合投入；報導稱，已公佈的公部門與民間資金承諾合計4億美元。海軍資金透過Defense Exportability Features計畫提供。

en.title: Shield AI keeps X-BAT on track for late-2026 flight testing as Navy funds program
en.summary: Shield AI says X-BAT remains targeted for late-2026 flight testing; Navy executes funded modification
body: Shield AI says X-BAT remains on track to begin flight testing in late 2026. The source reports that a team of 500 engineers is working on the autonomous combat aircraft, with engineers based at Shield AI and key suppliers, including engine provider GE Aerospace.

The US Navy has executed a funded modification for the X-BAT programme. Shield AI is to match the investment with $150 million of its own, and the source says announced public and private commitments total $400 million. The Navy funding is coming through its Defense Exportability Features programme.

facts.sourceQuote: The current plan remains for the aircraft to achieve its first flight testing in late 2026.

facts.sourceQuote: Yesterday, Shield AI’s X-BAT programme got a major boost by attracting investment from the US Navy. The service has executed the $150 million modification with funding.
